search_queries: Minnesota Direct Care and Treatment "Community Behavioral Health Hospital" standard charges price transparency
established: The first-party DCT Community Behavioral Health Hospitals page (https://mn.gov/dct/adult-services/inpatient-care/community-behavioral-health-hospitals/index.jsp, metadata dc.modified 2025-08-26) lists all four facilities with matching roster addresses: Alexandria 1610 8th Avenue East 56308; Bemidji 800 Bemidji Avenue North Suite 200 56601; Fergus Falls 1801 West Alcott Avenue 56538; Rochester 251 Wood Lake Drive Southeast 55904.
mn.gov is confirmed as the publisher's own domain for these state-operated hospitals; no separate facility domain exists.

Site-restricted search of mn.gov/dct for billing/charges/rates returned only cost-of-care fact sheets (Forensic Services, Community Based Services, MSOP, all dated 2026-04-01); none covers CBHH standard charges and none is a CMS-template CSV/JSON MRF.
No facility-specific pricing page, cms-hpt.txt pointer, or publisher CSV/JSON was found for any of the four CCNs.
not_established: Whether DCT publishes standard charges anywhere outside search-indexed pages.
Whether any of the four CCNs are exempt; no exemption is inferred.
changed_vs_prior: New 2026-10-01 site-restricted search evidence; the prior review (2026-09-22) had the same pointer-not-retrieved outcome, so no disposition change.
